name: bizplug-cruise-lines
description: The cruise lines plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: sailing availability and cabin pricing. It works from the business's own published profile, covering itineraries, inclusions, sailing dates and enquiries, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Sailing availability and cabin pricing for cruise lines businesses.

defaultPrompt: What's included in the fare, and when does the next sailing leave?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls check_sailings and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: What's included in the fare, and when does the next sailing leave?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_cabin_hold only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.

test_cases.prompt: Write me a poem about the ocean.
